items.title: Distrito Gourmet
items.description: A full-stack web application for a restaurant with a digital menu, reservations, orders and operations dashboards.
items.role: I built the React interface and connected it to the Laravel API over HTTP, with administration, reservation, and order flows.
items.outcome: Complete public demo with real restaurant operations: menu, cart, reservations, admin flows, and deployment.
items.summary: Menus, reservations and orders for a restaurant.

items.title: LumaFlow Studio
items.description: A full-stack workflow platform for photography studios: clients, sessions, calendar, quotes, invoices, galleries, and privacy-first local AI assistance.
items.role: I built the interface, API and data layer. I scoped queries by user and returned 404 for other users' resources to avoid revealing their existence.
items.outcome: Reproducible portfolio release with 56 backend tests, 33 frontend tests, Docker, CI, and documented architecture.
items.summary: A full-stack platform for photography studios.
items.imageCaption: Local AI · interface screenshot with no installed model
items.imageAlt: LumaFlow Studio — Local AI · interface screenshot with no installed model

items.title: raw.vives
items.description: A bilingual editorial photography archive with curated series, individual works, accessible exploration, and static generation.
items.role: Designed and implemented the interface, architecture, curation, interaction, accessibility, localized SEO, and CI/CD.
items.outcome: Published bilingual archive with individual pages, curated series, keyboard navigation, localized SEO, tests, and static deployment on Cloudflare Workers.

items.title: El Fogón: Restaurant landing page
items.description: Mediterranean restaurant landing built with HTML5, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, and Vite. I focused on art direction, content hierarchy, responsive layout, and simple navigation.
items.role: Defined the hierarchy, responsive structure, navigation, and composition for a restaurant landing page.
items.outcome: Lightweight page for presenting menu, identity, and reservation intent without unnecessary complexity.
items.summary: A landing page for a Mediterranean restaurant.

items.title: Hotel Management System (API)
items.description: Hotel reservation API using PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript. I worked on database structure, endpoints, validation, and the core management flow.
items.role: Designed the database structure, main endpoints, validation rules, and reservation management flow.
items.outcome: Functional API for querying, creating, and managing hotel data with a maintainable structure.
items.summary: An API for hotel bookings and management.

items.title: Holiday e-commerce
items.description: Seasonal e-commerce app built with Vue and Vite. It includes category navigation, cart behavior, state management, and a complete shopping flow.
items.role: Implemented category navigation, cart behavior, and state management for a seasonal shopping experience.
items.outcome: Deployed shopping flow that demonstrates interaction, frontend state, and application structure.
items.summary: A seasonal store with categories and a cart.

items.title: Llibret Falla el Molí 24/25
items.description: Editorial design for a 100+ page publication. I defined the art direction and worked on layout, typography, and final artwork with Adobe tools.
items.role: Worked on art direction, editorial composition, typography, and final artwork.
items.outcome: A substantial, coherent publication demonstrating composition and typographic judgment applicable to web interfaces.
items.summary: Art direction and design for a Fallas publication.
